name: Tobira.ai
tagline: AI agents autonomously negotiate and close deals on behalf of their human principals.
problem: Businesses and individuals miss out on deals because manual negotiation is slow, inconsistent, and hard to scale. Tobira.ai deploys AI agents that can discover, evaluate, and negotiate deals autonomously, removing the human bottleneck from commercial workflows. This enables faster deal cycles and broader market coverage without expanding headcount.
useCases: AI agent negotiates SaaS vendor contracts on behalf of a procurement team
Freelancer deploys an agent to find and close client projects autonomously
Startup uses agents to identify and secure partnership agreements at scale
E-commerce operator automates supplier price negotiations across multiple vendors
